newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Italy's BCI places HK$300 mln FRCD.
newsitem.headline: Italy's BCI places HK$300 mln FRCD.

text.p: Banca Commerciale Italiana (BCI), acting through its Hongkong branch, has privately placed a HK$300 million floating rate certificates of deposit issue due June 26, 1998, the arrangers and lead managers said on Tuesday.
The one-year certificates were issued at par to float at 10 basis points over one-month Hong Kong Interbank Offered Rate.
DKB Asia, Fuji International Finance (HK) and Tokyo-Mitsubishi International (HK) are the arrangers and lead managers.
Banca Commerciale Italiana's Hongkong branch is paying and reference agent.
The payment date is June 26. Governing law is Hong Kong.
